description: Defines a final immutable Java class 'RetrieveResource' used as a command to retrieve a Resource based on Policy ID, Label, and ResourceKey within a policies query context. It includes methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, getters, and overrides for equality, hash, and string representation.

classes.name: RetrieveResource
classes.description: An immutable command class to retrieve a Resource from policies based on Policy ID, Label, and ResourceKey, with JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances of RetrieveResource using either string Policy ID or PolicyId object, along with Label, ResourceKey, and optional DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveResource instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with optional headers.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with this retrieve command.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the ResourceKey for resource retrieval.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JsonPointer path for locating the resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's main fields into a JsonObjectBuilder based on schema and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new RetrieveResource instance with updated headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality of this object with another RetrieveResource.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Supports equality checks by confirming other object type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code based on object properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
